crossRefs.note: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.
King Solomon made a fleet of ships in Ezion Geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of…
The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious…
and tell Tyre, ‘You who dwell at the entry of the sea, who are the merchant of the peoples to many islands, the Lord…

translations.web: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.
translations.bsb: She is like the merchant ships, bringing her food from afar.
translations.kjv: She is like the merchants' ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
translations.asv: She is like the merchant-ships; She bringeth her bread from afar.
